defects.modern: Door opens, a leg out, stand up and step clear in 0.8-1.2 s; from a moving car a dive-and-roll.
defects.ours: User saw the figure crouch and slide for seconds. Parked-car exit in a34_after3/b_exit_third.mp4 is short (0.6 s) but the climb-out pose is held while the game walks the ped off the door (state 4), so any longer state 4 (a moving or blocked car) reads as a crouching glide.
defects.note: Clamp the out clip to its own length, then blend into walk/idle driven by the measured ped speed; from a moving car play a roll.

defects.item: Chase camera loses the player (on foot)
defects.modern: The player is always framed: collision probes pull the camera in but never past the head; occluders fade; the rig never looks straight down on an empty spot.
defects.ours: Repeatedly the third-person frame has no player in it: after a warp or near walls/steps the camera looks down at paving (a34_after5/b_turn.mp4, qb_b/shot_050.png, a34_after3/b_walk_0.mp4 first second), it sits inside the phone booth (qa3_booth_camera_inside.png, walk_booth_fill.png), or frames a shop front after leaving a car (qa_crash_11_third_out.png); the player is cut off at the bottom edge (walk_cut_off.png).

defects.item: Street views desaturate to greyscale (new [visuals] pass)
defects.modern: Colour grading that never drains the picture.
defects.ours: On the shared stage of 16:32 (VISUALS pass in it) the whole 3D world turned grey while the HUD stayed in colour: qb_a mean HSV saturation 60-82 early, 7 from ~2.5 min on; qb_b 2 from the first car entry to the end. Regression of the in-flight pass, not in a release.

defects.modern: Ped sprints alongside, grabs the handle, door opens, a vault or yank into the seat in ~1 s; the car keeps moving; the camera blends from the on-foot rig to the car rig.
defects.ours: User report: the figure slides along beside the car in the crouch pose while the game drags the ped with it. Not re-filmed: in 150 s at the busiest Downtown kerb no driven car passed within 1.8 blocks (qb_b, item moving), which is itself the traffic-density defect below.
defects.note: Match the figure to the door's world position each frame (pin the hip to the car's door anchor), play a run-alongside then a jump-in clip; never draw the ped translating with the car while standing.

defects.item: First-person own car: hood tears into black shards / yellow ribbons
defects.modern: A clean, stable cockpit or bonnet view at any damage.
defects.ours: After knocks the own car's hull from the driver's seat breaks into black spikes filling the lower half (qa_long_016_first.png) or yellow streamers across the view (qa_long_028_first.png): the dented copy plus the cabin clip planes. Missed by QA3.

defects.modern: Over-the-shoulder aim camera, reticle that turns red on a target, lock-on for pads, hit markers, tracers, impacts, recoil, punchy muzzle light.
defects.ours: No reticle and no aim camera in the street views: the shot goes wherever the game ped faces; muzzle glow and cases exist but are small; impacts are tiny sparks; from the high chase angle the figure is a few pixels tall (shoot_anim_sheet).

defects.item: Getting in: hard cut to a far chase rig
defects.modern: One continuous blend from the shoulder rig to the vehicle rig over ~0.6 s, keeping the car's door in frame.
defects.ours: The frame jumps in one step from the close on-foot camera to a high, distant car camera (enter_third clip 1.6 s -> 2.2 s); the car then sits small in the middle of the frame.

defects.item: Body roll, pitch, suspension, wheel spin and steer
defects.modern: Sprung bodies that roll in turns, squat and dive, wheels that spin and steer.
defects.ours: Shipped stage: rigid bodies glued to the road plane. VEHICLE-FEEL (dll/src/vehicle_fx.cpp) is in flight, not yet staged or verified.

defects.modern: Dense, varied traffic and crowds near the player, thinning naturally with distance.
defects.ours: Wide boulevards nearly empty in the street views (qa_crash_02_third_speed.png, cam3_r3 car-out frames); in 150 s at the busiest Downtown kerb no driven car passed within 1.8 blocks (qb_b). The game's spawn ring was sized for the top-down screen.

defects.item: No sun shadows in the shipped plain renderer
defects.modern: Cascaded sun shadows, contact shadows under feet and tyres, AO.
defects.ours: Figures and cars float on the ground with no shadow in every shipped frame; the [visuals] pass (shadows, SSAO, bloom) is in flight on the stage, see the greyscale row.

defects.modern: Modelled hedges, iron railings, trees with alpha-tested foliage.
defects.ours: Downtown park fences carry rows of dark, blocky extruded blobs with orange specks (the sprite's pixels pushed into 3D) that loom in every frame along the parks (qa_long_016/028/045).

defects.modern: Subtitles in a readable sans with a backing panel, speaker name, voice; a separate objective line; pager history.
defects.ours: Pixel font in blue/gold straight over the world, one line scrolling across the middle of the screen (walk_1 strip: 'lost ya bum! It costs $50,000 ...'), the talking-head portrait at low res.

defects.item: Sound is panned for the top-down camera
defects.modern: 3D positional audio relative to the camera: engines, footsteps, gunfire with distance, occlusion and reverb.
defects.ours: The renderer has no audio code; the game's mixer pans and attenuates by the top-down screen, so a car behind the chase camera sounds as if on screen. No footsteps, no door, cloth or impact foley for the new animations.
evidence: grep: no DirectSound/mss32 code in dll/src or src

defects.modern: Door yanked, driver pulled out and thrown to the road, player takes the seat; victim reacts (falls, runs or fights).
defects.ours: No jack-specific clip: both figures play the generic crouch in/out at the door; the victim's fall is the generic knock-down.

defects.modern: Weighted strikes with anticipation, follow-through, root motion into the target, contact on the target, hit-stop of 2-4 frames, a camera nudge and a hit sound.
defects.ours: A stiff straight-arm jab with no weight shift, repeated; the swing does not track the target and nothing marks contact (a34_after5 punch clips). Kicks: none (GTA2 has none; the attack key is only the punch).

defects.modern: Directional flinch per hit (head, torso, stagger back), partial-body additive reactions while running.
defects.ours: No flinch layer: a punched or shot ped keeps walking until the game puts him down, then the fall clip.

defects.modern: Ragdoll death with blend to rest; WASTED as a slow-motion desaturated beat on the body, then a fade to the hospital and a walk-out.
defects.ours: Lying clips chosen by cause (good), but WASTED is drawn with the camera on a wall or the empty street: the body is not framed (qa3_army_wasted_third.png); respawn is a cut.

defects.item: Cinematics on JOB COMPLETE / WASTED / BUSTED
defects.modern: A short framed beat: slow motion, orbit or push-in on the player, letterbox, the title, music sting, then a fade.
defects.ours: The 2D title over whatever the chase camera points at; JOB COMPLETE shows the mission text box and the player standing (pt_wil4_jobcomplete.png).

defects.modern: Volumetric fireball, light flash on surroundings, shock wave, flying parts, lingering smoke column, a charred wreck.
defects.ours: The game's 2D flame and explosion sprites stood up as billboards (cardboard look, white glare quads in camera_polish_sheet row 5); wreck models exist; no debris or flying wheel yet (VEHICLE-FEEL plans it).

defects.modern: Motion-matched locomotion: stride locked to speed, foot plant without sliding, lean into acceleration and turns, arm swing, run starts and stops.
defects.ours: Rocketbox walk/run clips, stride matched and smoothed; reads acceptable at distance. Up close the figure is light: no acceleration lean, no start/stop transitions, feet slide when the game snaps speed.

defects.modern: Pivot steps (90/180-degree turn clips) with foot planting; a quick 180 has a skid-turn.
defects.ours: The drawn yaw is eased (240 deg/s) over an idle or walk pose: the figure rotates on the spot like a turntable.

defects.item: Car chase framing (too high, too far)
defects.modern: Low, close chase (car ~35-45 % of frame width), speed-dependent FOV and pull-back, look-ahead into turns.
defects.ours: The car sits small at frame centre under a high camera; speed adds little sense of motion (enter_cut_far.png, qa3_crash_02).

defects.modern: Hundreds of combinations: body types, ages, outfits, props (bags, phones, umbrellas).
defects.ours: 41 Rocketbox avatars mapped by remap type; the plain civilians reuse a small set, no children or elderly, no carried props; the player looks like a passer-by (striped polo, shorts).

defects.modern: Crisp painted lines with wear.
defects.ours: Zebra crossings and arrows show ESRGAN/SD noise (squiggly black inside the white bars) at street level (qa3_bust4_100.png, a33 soldier frames).

defects.modern: Depth: recessed windows, sills, cornices, signage, interior mapping behind glass.
defects.ours: Buildings are the map's boxes with one texture per face: flat windows, flat doors; glass-fronted shops read as smeared panels in first person (qa_crash_10).

defects.item: Original HUD sprites over the 3D view
defects.modern: Minimal modern HUD: health/armour arc, mini-map with route, money, wanted stars, ammo; fades when idle; scaled for 1080p+.
defects.ours: GTA2's 640x480-era bars, hearts and digits pinned to the corners, small and low contrast over a bright sky (every frame). A modern HUD (hud3d, [hud] modern=1) is in flight, not staged.

defects.modern: Ragdoll: thrown over the bonnet or under the wheels, physically driven by the car's speed and direction.
defects.ours: The `runover` lying clip plays (verified in the showcase and in logs, 17 bodies), the same canned arc whatever the car's speed or side; the car does not react.

defects.modern: Officer cuffs on contact, short cutscene-like framing, fade to the station.
defects.ours: Hands up, cuffed, led to the car (acted out, verified) but the camera does not frame it: the BUSTED frame shows the empty crossing while the player is out of shot (qa3_bust4_100.png); cop car body interpenetrates the truck in pol_arrest3.

defects.modern: A per-weapon reload clip with mag drop/insert and sound, in third and first person.
defects.ours: The reload timer (+2 of the weapon object) is read, but there is no reload clip in either view.

defects.modern: Decals that project onto the surface they hit, wet sheen, spray particles; bullet holes on walls.
defects.ours: Blood is the game's flat sprites: pools lie on the ground correctly but stood-up splats read as red cardboard (red upright blob in the a33 train frames); no bullet holes.

defects.item: First-person cab: black slab or tiny nub for a hood
defects.modern: Interior or a believable bonnet line with mirrors and dash.
defects.ours: Van cab: a dark featureless slab across the bottom third (doors_dents_sheet, driver's-seat row); truck: a tiny green nub with an ornament (qa_crash_15_first_drive.png).

defects.modern: Tyre smoke on burnouts and slides, persistent skid decals, exhaust heat and puffs.
defects.ours: GTA2's own flat skid sprites only; no smoke, no exhaust (in flight in VEHICLE-FEEL).

defects.modern: Bodies that touch, crumple, push and scrape with sparks.
defects.ours: The game's 2D boxes decide contact, so 3D bodies overlap (cop car through the truck cab in the arrest frames); no sparks or scrape.

defects.modern: Flee, cower, film, scream, call the police, react to near misses and gunfire.
defects.ours: The game's AI runs (they flee and fight), but the figures have no fear/cower/point clips: a fleeing crowd jogs.

defects.item: Time of day and night in the plain renderer
defects.modern: A day cycle with golden hour, blue hour, lit windows, street-lamp pools, neon.
defects.ours: Plain mode keeps a fixed late-afternoon sun (follow_clock=0); forcing the sun to -6 deg only dims the scene: blue horizon, no lamp pools, no lit windows (props2_wiln5 t_lights_third.png). Night only exists under RTX Remix.

defects.item: Phone booth: oversized box and PHONE sign
defects.modern: A period booth at human scale that frames a mission start.
defects.ours: The booth model and its PHONE sign are huge next to the player and fill the frame when the camera nears it (walk_booth_fill.png, pt9 BLOW JOB frame).

defects.modern: Reflections, waves, foam at edges, refraction.
defects.ours: A flat turquoise textured plane (env_water_wil_after shot_005.png).

defects.item: Phone ring prompt and mission markers
defects.modern: World-space marker over the booth, ring sound with direction, mini-map blip, on-screen 'answer' hint.
defects.ours: The game's small 2D arrow and the ring sound (not positional to the 3D camera); the booth itself has no ringing light.

defects.modern: A stop clip with a settle step; idle with breathing, weight shifts, glances, occasional fidgets.
defects.ours: Walk snaps to a single idle loop; no stop step, no idle variety.

defects.modern: Distinct carry/aim poses per class, visible weapon models with lights and sights.
defects.ours: Per-weapon carry and aim stances and models exist and match the game's weapon word (verified); models are low detail and dull at chase distance.

defects.modern: Lamps with light cast on the road at night, brake flare.
defects.ours: Glows on the bodies (verified), brake flare by deceleration; no light on the road in the plain renderer (VEHICLE-FEEL adds pools).

defects.modern: No visible pop: fade-in at the edge of the streaming radius.
defects.ours: Fog 18-130 blocks hides most of it; props pop at 36 blocks and peds appear at the spawn ring's edge.

defects.modern: Rain with wet roads and reflections, fog banks, wind in trees.
defects.ours: None.

defects.modern: Large-scale variation, decals (cracks, stains, manholes), parallax.
defects.ours: 512 px HD tiles; paving is fine up close but repeats per block; dirt blotches repeat visibly.

defects.modern: Street clutter: bins, signs, parked bikes, kiosks, awnings, litter, planters.
defects.ours: Rule-placed lamps, bins, benches, hydrants, meters (verified); streets still bare between them.

defects.modern: Dynamic clouds, sun disc and glare tied to the light.
defects.ours: Dome with clouds and haze (fine); sun fixed in plain mode.

defects.modern: Instant or short eased switch, no pop.
defects.ours: 1.4 s arc between views with FOV ease (verified, smooth); level start always opens in the classic view.

defects.modern: Panel deformation, detached bumpers, broken glass, smoke from the engine.
defects.ours: Noise dents in 4 steps (verified), but the dent step still reads the low byte of the damage word (actions-3d.md: should be int16/8000), so dents can reset as damage rises.

defects.item: First person: lamp post / wall fills the frame
defects.modern: Near-clip fade of props in front of the eye.
defects.ours: A lamp post draws as a black bar beside the eye (qa_crash_10_first_out_turned.png, QA3 finding 3).

defects.modern: Floating pickup names, '+$100' that rises and fades in world space.
defects.ours: Pickups are 3D models on rings (verified); score pops are the game's 2D digits (hud_pass keeps them over the ped).

defects.modern: Radio stations in cars with DJ talk, music stingers on mission start/complete, wanted-level music.
defects.ours: The game's radio plays in cars (nostalgic, keep); no stingers tied to the new cinematics.

defects.modern: Straight into the world, or a styled loading screen with tips.
defects.ours: The original 'GET READY' screen and menu (nostalgic, keep); the level opens in the classic view, the 3D view needs a V press.

feel.heading: fluid
feel.proposal: The player is always in the third-person frame: collision pull-in stops at the head, occluders (booths, posts, walls) fade, no top-down stare after warps or exits
feel.target: player's head inside the frame in >= 99.5 % of third-person frames of a QA sweep (detector on the figure's projected bbox); 0 frames inside a prop

feel.heading: fluid
feel.proposal: Car entry/exit anchored to the door: hip pinned to the door anchor every frame, out clip capped at its own length then locomotion; run-alongside + jump-in for moving cars, dive-roll out of them
feel.target: figure-to-door error < 0.1 block per frame; no frame with the crouch pose and ped speed > 0.3 block/s; exit to free walk <= 1.0 s

feel.heading: fun/addictive
feel.proposal: WASTED and BUSTED as a framed beat: 0.3x slow motion on the body or the cuffing for 1.5 s, push-in, desaturate, the title, fade to the hospital/station
feel.target: body or arrest inside the frame in 100 % of WASTED/BUSTED frames; total beat <= 4 s; no cut to an empty street

feel.heading: nostalgic
feel.proposal: Keep GTA2's saturated retro palette: a 'GTA2' colour grade preset, never a grey or washed-out world
feel.target: mean saturation of street frames >= the classic view's on the same spot

feel.heading: magical
feel.proposal: City life: denser traffic and crowds around the player in the street views (spawn ring sized for the 3D view)
feel.target: >= 6 driven cars and >= 10 pedestrians within 12 blocks on a Downtown boulevard at any time; frame p99 still <= 33 ms

feel.heading: fluid
feel.proposal: One continuous camera through every transition (on foot <-> car, death, arrest, respawn): blended rigs, no single-frame jump
feel.target: camera position change per frame <= 0.5 block and yaw <= 25 deg outside an explicit cut (GTA2DX9_LOG_CAMERA); blends 0.5-0.7 s

feel.heading: realistic
feel.proposal: Grounding: sun and contact shadows, AO under feet and tyres, foot IK on kerbs and slopes (the [visuals] pass, fixed so it never greys the world)
feel.target: a shadow under every figure and car by day; mean saturation of street frames within 10 % of the classic view

feel.heading: fun/addictive
feel.proposal: Mission start and JOB COMPLETE cinematics: letterbox, orbit on the player, money counted up, a music sting
feel.target: 2-3 s beat on every mission start/complete; money rolls up over 0.8 s; skippable with any key

feel.heading: realistic
feel.proposal: Weight in cars: sprung body, roll in turns, dive and squat, spinning and steering wheels, tyre smoke and skids (VEHICLE-FEEL, in flight)
feel.target: roll <= 6 deg, pitch <= 3 deg, settling in 0.4 s; wheels spin with distance

feel.heading: fun/addictive
feel.proposal: Combat feedback: hit-stop, directional flinch, camera nudge, hit markers, impact decals and sounds
feel.target: 50 ms hit-stop on a landed punch; flinch within 1 frame of the game's health drop; camera kick <= 0.3 deg

feel.heading: realistic
feel.proposal: Sound matches sight: 3D positional audio relative to the street camera, footsteps and door/impact foley
feel.target: a car behind the chase camera is heard behind; footsteps on every walk cycle

feel.heading: magical
feel.proposal: Time of day in the plain renderer: golden hour, blue hour, night with lit windows, lamp pools and neon
feel.target: follow_clock on by default in plain mode; at 22:00 >= 30 % of facades show lit windows and every street lamp casts a pool

feel.heading: fun/addictive
feel.proposal: Aiming in the street views: over-the-shoulder aim camera and a reticle that marks the target the game will hit
feel.target: reticle on screen while armed; the target the game picks highlighted >= 90 % of shots

feel.heading: fluid
feel.proposal: Locomotion with start, stop and pivot-turn clips and speed-driven blending
feel.target: foot slide < 2 cm per frame at walk/run; crossfades 150-250 ms; a 180-degree turn uses a pivot clip, never a turntable spin

feel.heading: nostalgic
feel.proposal: Celebrate the mission text and talking heads: same lines and humour, re-typeset in a readable period face on a panel, portrait upscaled, voice kept
feel.target: subtitle legible at 720p from 2 m (>= 18 px cap height); text never scrolls through mid-screen

feel.heading: realistic
feel.proposal: Damage persists and reads: dents from the int16 damage word, engine smoke from 16000, sparks on scrapes, debris on explosions
feel.target: dent step monotonic with damage; smoke on every car with damage >= 16000

feel.heading: fun/addictive
feel.proposal: Score pops and money in world space; kill-frenzy presentation (timer, counter, red vignette, music)
feel.target: every +$ shown over its source within 1 frame, rising and fading over 1 s; frenzy timer always visible

feel.heading: realistic
feel.proposal: Explosions as volumetric fireballs with a light flash and a smoke column instead of stood-up sprites
feel.target: no flat sprite visible edge-on; flash lights surfaces within 3 blocks for 0.3 s

feel.heading: nostalgic
feel.proposal: Keep the instant top-down switch (V) and the classic view untouched; open the level in the player's last view
feel.target: V switch <= 1.4 s; classic frames byte-identical to the original renderer

feel.heading: nostalgic
feel.proposal: Original HUD available as an option, scaled crisply; the modern HUD keeps GTA2's icons and colours
feel.target: [hud] modern=0 restores the original exactly

feel.heading: fluid
feel.proposal: Input-to-motion latency and frame pacing measured and held
feel.target: key press to first figure movement <= 100 ms; p99 frame time <= 33 ms with no hitch > 50 ms in a 5-minute drive (frame_log)

feel.heading: magical
feel.proposal: Weather: rain with wet, reflective roads and puddles; fog mornings
feel.target: a rain spell every ~20 game minutes; wet-road reflection of lamps and car lights

feel.heading: fun/addictive
feel.proposal: Near-miss moments: a car passing within 0.3 block at speed gives a whoosh, a camera nudge and a brief 0.8x time feel
feel.target: triggered on >= 80 % of logged near misses; never during a cut

feel.heading: magical
feel.proposal: Water with reflection, waves and shoreline foam
feel.target: sky and buildings reflected; no flat turquoise plane

feel.heading: magical
feel.proposal: Music and radio cues on events (wanted level up, mission start, frenzy)
feel.target: a cue within 0.5 s of the event; radio resumes on car entry

feel.heading: nostalgic
feel.proposal: Radio stations, DJs and voices untouched; the 1960s retro-futurist car look finished (Furore GT, Meteor still modern-looking)
feel.target: all 73 vehicle types pass the era brief
